consequence.statement: Existing SecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. A storage version migration (rewriting all objects) and an update to status.storedVersions are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all SecretStore objects so they are stored as v1. Then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions on the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD.

assertion.statement: From 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the storage version of the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1. Existing SecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. Before a later release removes v1beta1, operators must run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions.
